referenceFunction.generalComment: Data are based on information in a US-EPA LCA study about LCD and CRT production. The data represent the respective efforts for a 15-inch LCD computer screen, as it is produced in Japan. 2023 updates: According to the recent market statistics for TFT-LCD modules, the largest producers globally are: BOE, LG Display, Innolyx Corp, AUO, Samsung, and China Star, all representing more than 80% market share (Cision, 2010; Statista, 2020). The electricity consumption are nevertheless regionalized according to the market share and producing regions, namely China (40%), Japan (30%), and Taiwan (30%). The current version of the UVEK LCA database allows for the inclusion of Taiwan electricity mix into the updated dataset unlike the previous version. The energy efficiency improvement concerning heat and electricity is also applied for the module production (Cantini et al., 2022).; Geography: Data from literature (based on information from Japanese producers) used as data for the global production average; UUID: d6148644-7e62-3ab5-b98e-f4b9361b3708
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the auxiliaries and energy efforts as well as the related emissions (air/water) and waste amounts for the assembly of the complete LCD module. Estimations for infrastructure and the overall transport amounts (incl. for the materials in the LCD module) are included as well.
referenceFunction.name: Assembly, LCD module, at plant

geography.text: Data from literature (based on information from Japanese producers) used as data for the global production average
